label: Response number
definition: Sequential number assigned after exclusions; original survey aliases omitted

label: Self-reported cumulative GPA
definition: Used as supplied without further rounding

label: Short-form video use
definition: Self-reported use of short-form video platforms

label: Text-based platform use
definition: Self-reported reading or participation in text-based social media

label: Calls and messaging
definition: Self-reported communication including phone and messaging apps

label: Time off social media before bed
definition: Minutes between stopping social media use and sleeping

label: Total reported social media use
definition: Derived in R as short_video_hours + text_hours + communication_hours; categories may overlap
